31206-burgoyne-s-invasion-of-1777-with-a.creator: Unknown
31206-burgoyne-s-invasion-of-1777-with-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. England took Canada from France in 1759, and soon after annexed it to her own dominions. Twelve years later, her despotic acts drove her American colonies into open rebellion. England feared, and the colonies hoped, Canada would join in the revolt against her.

70427-history-for-ready-reference-volume.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1906-02805.title: Search for the production of four top quarks in the single-lepton and opposite-sign dilepton final states in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 \TeV
arxiv-1906-02805.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by . A search for the standard model production of four top quarks ( \Pp ​ \Pp → \cPqt ​ \cPaqt ​ \cPqt ​ \cPaqt \Pp\Pp\to\cPqt\cPaqt\cPqt\cPaqt ) is reported using single-lepton plus jets and opposite-sign dilepton plus jets signatures. Proton-proton collisions are recorded with the CMS detector at the LHC at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV in a sample corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 35.8 \fbinv .

arxiv-2104-14409.title: Bose-Fermi trasmutation for one-dimensional harmonic trap
arxiv-2104-14409.creator: J. Nisperuza 1 , JP Rubio 1 and R. Avella 1
arxiv-2104-14409.description: Abstract Using Density Matrix renormalization group (DMRG), we study the ground state properties of spin one-half fermions and scalar bosons in the soft-core limit, with weak s-wave inter and intra species interactions. We considered the system subject to one-dimensional (1D) optical lattice and a superimposed potential at zero temperature, in the framework of Bose-Fermi-Hubbard model.

arxiv-2202-07501.title: Many-body approximations to the superfluid gap and critical temperature in pure neutron matter
arxiv-2202-07501.creator: Mehdi Drissi ad:triumf,ad:surrey,em:md, Arnau Rios ad:icc,ad:surrey,em:arh
arxiv-2202-07501.description: Abstract We compute singlet pairing gaps and critical temperatures in pure neutron matter with different many-body approximations. Medium effects tend to reduce gaps and critical temperatures compared to the standard BCS ansatz. In the mean-field approximation, the ratio of these two quantities remains constant across a wide range of densities.

arxiv-2203-12061.title: Generation of Super Intense Isolated Attosecond Pulses from Trapped Electrons in Metal Surfaces
arxiv-2203-12061.creator: Younes Adnani, Abdelmalek Taoutioui, Abdelkader Makhoute, Károly Tőkési, Hicham Agueny
arxiv-2203-12061.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Younes Adnani, Abdelmalek Taoutioui, Abdelkader Makhoute, Károly Tőkési, Hicham Agueny. Generation of ultrabroadband isolated attosecond pulses (IAPs) is essential for time-resolved applications in chemical and material sciences, as they have the potential to access the spectral water window region of chemical elements, which yet has to be established. Here we propose a numerical scheme for highly efficient high-order harmonic generation (HHG) and hence the generation of ultrabroadband IAPs in the XUV and soft x-ray regions.

arxiv-2204-12307.title: Scheduling of Sensor Transmissions Based on Value of Information for Summary Statistics
arxiv-2204-12307.creator: Federico Chiariotti, Anders E. Kalør, Josefine Holm, Beatriz Soret, Petar Popovski
arxiv-2204-12307.description: Abstract The optimization of Value of Information (VoI) in sensor networks integrates awareness of the measured process in the communication system. However, most existing scheduling algorithms do not consider the specific needs of monitoring applications, but define VoI as a generic Mean Square Error (MSE) of the whole system state regardless of the relevance of individual components.

arxiv-2205-02417.title: Channel-Adaptive Wireless Image Transmission with OFDM
arxiv-2205-02417.creator: Haotian Wu, Yulin Shao, Krystian Mikolajczyk, Deniz Gündüz
arxiv-2205-02417.description: Abstract We present a learning-based channel-adaptive joint source and channel coding (CA-JSCC) scheme for wireless image transmission over multipath fading channels. The proposed method is an end-to-end autoencoder architecture with a dual-attention mechanism employing orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) transmission.

arxiv-2308-02516.title: Exact solution of maximally flat antireflection coatings for coherent and incoherent light
arxiv-2308-02516.creator: Jaromír KŘEPELKA
arxiv-2308-02516.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jaromír KŘEPELKA. This paper presents two approaches to the precise design of maximally flat antireflection coatings reducing the reflectance of the substrate to near zero in a certain region around the central frequency. The first ideal case concerns coherent light interference, where it is required that for a chosen central frequency the maximum number of reflectance derivatives of the reflectance with respect to the frequency is zero.

arxiv-2310-12569.title: The discrete flow category: structure and computation Thanks: Email: bjornar.hem@epfl.ch
arxiv-2310-12569.creator: Bjørnar Gullikstad Hem
arxiv-2310-12569.description: Abstract . In this article, we use concepts and methods from the theory of simplicial sets to study discrete Morse theory. We focus on the discrete flow category introduced by Vidit Nanda, and investigate its properties in the case where it is defined from a discrete Morse function on a regular CW complex.

arxiv-2310-15443.title: Special Lagrangian pair of pants
arxiv-2310-15443.creator: Yang Li
arxiv-2310-15443.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yang Li. We construct special Lagrangian pair of pants in general dimensions, inside the cotangent bundle of T n T^{n} with the Euclidean structure. 1 Introduction A familiar picture on Riemann surfaces is the pair of pants decomposition . Each pair of pants is diffeomorphic to the thrice punctured S^{2} , and a general Riemann surface can be topologically built from gluing pair of pants along cylinders.

arxiv-2405-09560.title: Using In-Service Train Vibration for Detecting Railway Maintenance Needs
arxiv-2405-09560.creator: Irene Alisjahbana
arxiv-2405-09560.description: Abstract The need for the maintenance of railway track systems have been increasing. Traditional methods that are currently being used are either inaccurate, labor and time intensive, or does not enable continuous monitoring of the system. As a result, in-service train vibrations have been shown to be a cheaper alternative for monitoring of railway track systems.

arxiv-2411-04847.title: Prompt-Guided Internal States for Hallucination Detection of Large Language Models
arxiv-2411-04847.creator: Fujie Zhang §, Peiqi Yu §, Biao Yi ‡, Baolei Zhang ‡, Tong Li ‡, Zheli Liu ‡, {tongli, liuzheli}@nankai.edu.cn
arxiv-2411-04847.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fujie Zhang §, Peiqi Yu §, Biao Yi ‡, Baolei Zhang ‡, Tong Li ‡, Zheli Liu ‡, {tongli, liuzheli}@nankai.edu.cn. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a variety of tasks in different domains. However, they sometimes generate responses that are logically coherent but factually incorrect or misleading, which is known as LLM hallucinations. Data-driven supervised methods train hallucination detectors by leveraging the internal states of LLMs, but detectors trained on specific domains often struggle to generalize well to other domains.

arxiv-2502-07713.title: Geometric Interpretations of the k k -Nearest Neighbour Distributions
arxiv-2502-07713.creator: Kwanit Gangopadhyay, Arka Banerjee, Tom Abel
arxiv-2502-07713.description: Abstract The k k -Nearest Neighbour Cumulative Distribution Functions are measures of clustering for discrete datasets that are fast and efficient to compute. They are significantly more informative than the 2-point correlation function. Their connection to N N -point correlation functions, void probability functions and Counts-in-Cells is known.

arxiv-2502-14124.title: The Effect of Vera C. Rubin Observatory Cadence Selections on Kilonova Detectability
arxiv-2502-14124.creator: Cristina Andrade, Raiyah Alserkal, Luis Salazar Manzano, Emma Martin, Igor Andreoni, Michael W. Coughlin, Nidhal Guessoum, Liliana Rivera Sandoval
arxiv-2502-14124.description: Abstract The discovery of the optical/infra-red counterpart (AT2017gfo) to the binary neutron star gravitational-wave detection (GW170817), which was followed by a short gamma-ray burst (GRB170817), marked a groundbreaking moment in multi-messenger astronomy. To date, it remains the only confirmed joint detection of its kind. However, many experiments are actively searching for similar fast-fading electromagnetic counterparts, known as kilonovae.

arxiv-2505-09091.title: DPN-GAN: Inducing Periodic Activations in Generative Adversarial Networks for High-Fidelity Audio Synthesis
arxiv-2505-09091.creator: ZEESHAN AHMAD 1, SHUDI BAO 1, AND MENG CHEN 2
arxiv-2505-09091.description: Abstract In recent years, generative adversarial networks (GANs) have made significant progress in generating audio sequences. However, these models typically rely on bandwidth-limited mel-spectrograms, which constrain the resolution of generated audio sequences, and lead to mode collapse during conditional generation.

arxiv-2507-01879.title: Gravitational memory effects in Tachyon gravity arXiv: 1234.56789
arxiv-2507-01879.creator: Pouneh Safarzadeh Ilkhchi, Amin Rezaei Akbarieh, and Ali Seraj
arxiv-2507-01879.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore how a massless Tachyon field, when non-minimally coupled to gravity, affects gravitational memory, soft theorems, and symmetries near null infinity. We set up the model using both the Jordan and Einstein frames, work out the equations of motion and study the behavior of fields at large distances with the Bondi-Sachs gauge.

arxiv-2509-17265.title: Identifying and Upweighting Power-Niche Users to Mitigate Popularity Bias in Recommendations
arxiv-2509-17265.creator: David Liu, Erik Weis, Moritz Laber, Tina Eliassi-Rad, Brennan Klein
arxiv-2509-17265.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by David Liu, Erik Weis, Moritz Laber, Tina Eliassi-Rad, Brennan Klein. Recommender systems have been shown to exhibit popularity bias by over-recommending popular items and under-recommending relevant niche items. We seek to understand interactions with niche items in benchmark recommendation datasets as a step toward mitigating popularity bias. We find that, compared to mainstream users, niche-preferring users exhibit a longer-tailed activity-level distribution, indicating the existence of users who both prefer niche items and exhibit high activity levels.

pmc-10625293.title: Non-coding RNA-mediated endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition in human diabetic cardiomyopathy, potential regulation by DNA methylation
pmc-10625293.creator: Eric Wang, Shali Chen, Honglin Wang, Tori Chen, Subrata Chakrabarti
pmc-10625293.description: AimsDiabetic cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a major complication of diabetes and a risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Endothelial dysfunction is central to DCM, and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndMT) is a key form of endothelial dysfunction in diabetes. EndMT in DCM has been well-studied in model systems and has been found to be epigenetically regulated by non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs).

pmc-10669679.title: Investigating the Link between Eating Attitudes, Taste and Odour Preferences and the Chemical Senses
pmc-10669679.creator: Layla St Clair, Alyssa Grady, Mehmet K Mahmut, Carla Masala, Paolo Solla, Francesco Loy
pmc-10669679.description: Simple SummaryWomen with clinically diagnosed eating disorders have shown changes in their ability to taste and smell. However, whether this is true for non-clinical populations is unknown. We conducted the first study investigating whether high levels of disordered eating attitudes were associated with poorer taste and smell ability in a non-clinical sample.

pmc-10700570.title: Dataset of the catamaran floater in towing tank test with fix moment reference point
pmc-10700570.creator: Sayuti Syamsuar, Karyawan, Hendrato, Yudiawan Fajar Kusuma, Muhammad, Sulistiya, Annissa Roschyntawati, Daif Rahuna, Widyawasta, Baharuddin Ali, Sutiyo, Bagiyo Suwasono
pmc-10700570.description: Most seaplanes used for aircraft operations in territorial waters are classified into three main types, namely floatplanes, flying boats, and amphibians. Among these, the floatplane stands out as it replaced its landing gear with two floating pontoons, known as the catamaran floater, on which the fuselage rests.

pmc-11272920.title: Pan-immune-inflammation value and survival in patients with breast cancer from a Peruvian reference hospital
pmc-11272920.creator: Iris Palomino-Secca, Mariella Peña-Tuya, Lynn A Quintana-García, Miguel A Guevara Pinares, Dante M Quiñones-Laveriano, Robert Malpartida Palomino, Jhony A De La Cruz-Vargas
pmc-11272920.description: The pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV), calculated as (neutrophil × platelet × monocyte)/lymphocyte count, may be useful for estimating survival in breast cancer patients. To determine the prognostic value of PIV for overall survival in breast cancer patients in Lima, Peru. A retrospective cohort study was conducted.

pmc-11565033.title: Data-enabled Bayesian inference for strategic maintenance decisions in industrial operations
pmc-11565033.creator: Raúl Torres-Sainz, Leandro L Lorente-Leyva, Yorley Arbella-Feliciano, Carlos Alberto Trinchet-Varela, Lidia María Pérez-Vallejo, Roberto Pérez-Rodríguez
pmc-11565033.description: Efficient management of industrial assets and equipment depends heavily on the selection of appropriate maintenance strategies. This research presents a dataset generated through Monte Carlo simulations to evaluate 12 key criteria relevant to maintenance strategy selection. The dataset covers a wide range of potential maintenance scenarios, providing comprehensive data for researchers to explore various strategies in industrial settings.

pmc-11680055.title: Whole-Exome Sequencing, Mutational Signature Analysis, and Outcome in Multiple Myeloma—A Pilot Study
pmc-11680055.creator: Lorenz Oelschläger, Axel Künstner, Friederike Frey, Theo Leitner, Lisa Leypoldt, Niklas Reimer, Niklas Gebauer, Lorenz Bastian, Katja Weisel, Verena-Wilbeth Sailer, Christoph Röcken, Wolfram Klapper, Björn Konukiewitz, Eva Maria Murga Penas, Michael Forster, Natalie Schub, Helal M M Ahmed, Jutta Kir
pmc-11680055.description: The complex and heterogeneous genomic landscape of multiple myeloma (MM) and many of its clinical and prognostic implications remains to be understood. In other cancers, such as breast cancer, using whole-exome sequencing (WES) and molecular signatures in clinical practice has revolutionized classification, prognostic prediction, and patient management. However, such integration is still in its early stages in MM.

pmc-11689427.title: INTEGRATING AND IMPROVING MULTIPLE-METHOD RESEARCH IN AGING
pmc-11689427.creator: Pamela Saunders, Angela Perone
pmc-11689427.description: One of the basic tenets of mixed-method and mixed-methods research methodologies is that they integrate qualitative and quantitative data to provide a more holistic understanding of a research question. This interdisciplinary symposium examines several aging research projects to illustrate best practices for integrating and improving multiple methods research projects.

pmc-12635175.title: Telomere-to-telomere genome assembly of the Fraxinus mandshurica Rupr
pmc-12635175.creator: Dandan Zhang, Siyang Guo, Zicheng Zhang, Wa Gao, Xiyang Zhao, Mingwei Tang, Yanming Zhang, Qun Cai, Qiang Tian, Fang Luo, Hongtao Zhao
pmc-12635175.description: Fraxinus mandshurica Rupr, an important timber species, is widely distributed throughout northeastern China. In our study, we assembled the telomere-to-telomere (T2T) genome of F. mandshurica, generated by using Illumina short-read, PacBio HiFi long-read and Hi-C sequencing. The genome size was 781.40 Mb and the scaffold N50 length was 34.29 Mb. 39 contigs were reliably scaffolded into 23 T2T chromosomes.

pmc-13345938.title: Case Report: An integrated proposal for nutritional periodization and body mass loss management in a world boxing council super-bantamweight champion
pmc-13345938.creator: Carlos Abraham Herrera-Amante, Wiliam Carvajal-Veitía, Rodrigo Yáñez-Sepúlveda, José Francisco López-Gil
pmc-13345938.description: PurposeThis case study presents a 25-week nutritional period and body mass management strategy for a Mexican world champion that competes in the super bantamweight category. While the primary goal was to achieve competition weight, the intervention revealed unexpected physiological adaptations to prolonged energy restriction.MethodsA structured nutritional plan was implemented using multiple indicators of nutritional status.

pmc-13405584.title: FOS and Other Genes Linked to Oxidative Stress Are Upregulated in Women Suffering from Endometriosis and Might Negatively Impact the Oocyte Developmental Competence During ICSI
pmc-13405584.creator: Pawel Kordowitzki, Joanna Kochan, Jakub Wyroba
pmc-13405584.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Purpose: We aim to elucidate the impact of endometriomas on oocyte developmental competence and identify genetic alterations that may influence ICSI success rates in women of different ages. Methods: In this retrospective study, two groups of patients have been analyzed: 108 women with a history of severe endometriosis (stages III and IV), who underwent OPU and ICSI after endometriosis surgery, and a control group, built out of 108 women with no endometriosis history.

pmc-13406039.title: Characterization of Fecal Microbiota and Serum Metabolome Variations Across Different Gestational Stages in Hu Sheep
pmc-13406039.creator: Lanlan Li, Huibin Shi, Saiqiao Wang, Xueru Dou, Pengcheng Wang, Heng Fan, Xingchen Liu, Xiaoyin Zhang, Kai Quan, Yuqin Wang
pmc-13406039.description: Simple SummaryGestation requires significant nutrient redistribution in female animals, but the relationships between intestinal microbes and blood metabolic profiles during different pregnancy stages are not fully understood in sheep production. This study evaluated how the fecal microbial communities and blood biochemical parameters vary concurrently across different periods of pregnancy in Hu sheep.
